title: On the arithmetic of Tate-Shafarevich groups via Kolyvagin's conjecture
summary: We investigate how Heegner points detect the finiteness of the $p$-primary part of Tate-Shafarevich groups of semi-stable elliptic curves over the rationals of \emph{arbitrary} rank with any good reduction prime $p \geq 5$ with irreducible mod $p$ representation and partially recover Çiperiani--Wiles' theorem on solvable points on genus one curves. As a key ingredient of the proof of these results, we also give a concise proof of Kolyvagin's conjecture for semi-stable elliptic curves with supersingular reduction with a relevant choice of an imaginary quadratic field.
